# Agent skills for journalism
# https://skills.amditis.tech

## What this is

A collection of standards-based agent skills and Claude Code workflow hooks for journalists, researchers, academics, and media professionals. The skills provide specialized tools and workflows for compatible agents, including Claude Code and Codex. Claude-specific commands, agents, and hooks remain scoped to Claude Code.

Source: https://github.com/jamditis/claude-skills-journalism

## Who made it

Joe Amditis, associate director of operations, Center for Cooperative Media, Montclair State University.
Personal site: https://jamditis.com

## Hooks (17 workflow hooks)

Hooks run automatically at specific workflow events. Most are non-blocking warnings. `one-way-door-check` exits 2 to prevent irreversible architectural decisions. `no-ai-attribution` denies a commit, PR, or comment that carries AI authorship credit. `prose-question-guard` blocks a stop once to move a prose question into `AskUserQuestion`.

The standalone top-level hooks require manual setup from their reference files. Installing a skill package does not enable them. prose-question-guard runs with Python 3 on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

### Writing quality
- ap-style-check, flags AP Style violations on write/edit
- ai-slop-detector, warns about AI writing patterns
- accessibility-check, checks alt text, headings, link text
- copywriting-preflight, interviews for intent before drafting a new piece or revision

### Verification
- source-attribution-check, flags unattributed quotes or claims
- verification-reminder, prompts fact verification
- data-methodology-check, ensures methodology is documented

### Editorial workflow
- source-diversity-check, notes sourcing diversity
- legal-review-flag, flags potential defamation risk
- pre-publish-checklist, pre-publication reminder at session end
- deadline-tracker, surfaces upcoming deadlines at session start

### Preservation
- archive-reminder, reminds to archive URLs

### Interaction
- [prose-question-guard](https://skills.amditis.tech/prose-question-guard/), Stop hook that blocks once to move prose questions into AskUserQuestion; manual Python 3 install, Claude Code only

### Development
- one-way-door-check, blocks irreversible architectural decisions
- bug-report-detector, detects when user is describing a bug
- pre-commit-review, surfaces the staged diff for review before a commit and flags removed guardrails
- no-ai-attribution, blocks AI authorship credit in commits, PR bodies, and comments

## Plugins

Skills above are distributed as Claude Code plugins. Install them in Claude Code via:

```
/plugin marketplace add jamditis/claude-skills-journalism
/plugin install <plugin-name>@claude-skills-journalism
```

Restart your Claude Code session after installing or updating a plugin so the new skills and commands register.

Codex can use the repository's legacy-compatible marketplace route for the 16 nested `journalism-core` skills:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add jamditis/claude-skills-journalism
codex plugin add journalism-core@claude-skills-journalism
```

This repository does not ship native Codex manifests. The route does not convert Claude-specific commands, agents, hooks, or root-level skills into Codex components.

Plugins (14): `journalism-core` (16 skills), `newsroom-agent-ops` (9), `research-toolkit` (6), `dev-toolkit` (14), `security-toolkit` (5 skills + /hotpatch command), `project-templates-toolkit` (4), `pdf-design` (1), `pdf-playground` (1), `web-design-picker` (1), `visual-explainer` (1), `video-toolkit` (4), `okf-wiki` (1), `superjawn` (13), `autocontext` (cross-session knowledge persistence, hooks, commands, and agents rather than skills).

## Alternate installation

Install the 16 `journalism-core` skills through the Agent Skills standard for Codex:

```bash
npx skills@latest add https://github.com/jamditis/claude-skills-journalism/tree/master/journalism-core --skill '*' --agent codex --copy -g -y
```

For Claude Code, clone the repo and copy or symlink individual skill directories into `~/.claude/skills/`:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jamditis/claude-skills-journalism.git ~/projects/claude-skills-journalism
ln -sfn ~/projects/claude-skills-journalism/research-toolkit/skills/free-apis-catalog ~/.claude/skills/free-apis-catalog
```
